subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, we are excited to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on Saturday, October 30th. Join us for an elegant evening of dinner, live music, and a silent auction to raise funds for our cause. Your presence will make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we support. Please RSVP by October 15th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there!
